guidanceConsulted.query: embed cross-origin iframe lazy loading sandbox responsive
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: DO use loading="lazy" for iframes well outside the initial viewport so they do not compete with critical resources.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the below-the-fold showcase iframe carries loading="lazy" and a fixed height (520) so it reserves space and does not shift layout.
